comparables_contract.rule: same model name alone is never sufficient for a valid comparable

scarcity_contract.rule: structural scarcity and market scarcity must remain distinguishable

liquidity_contract.rule: asking prices never substitute for sold-event liquidity

north_star_gate.AUTONOMOUS: refresh, stale detection, contradiction and source fallback must be machine-operable where rights permit
north_star_gate.GLOBAL: region/language/price-discovery bias must be explicit and empirically testable
north_star_gate.IRREPLACEABLE_VALUE: every required field/assertion must trace to a customer decision and an output not sufficiently solved by generic search, a single marketplace or a single provider
north_star_gate.TRANSPARENT: provenance, rights, confidence, freshness, limitation and NOT_VERIFIED state must remain visible

anti_patterns: 32 independent bespoke schemas with no common grammar
provider data defining the product universe
